notes.title: Periodic updates completed for the fourth week of November !!
notes.content:
Hello. 
Thank you all for using "TAPP". 
I'm trying hard to be a perfect translator. 
Please give us lots of love. 

The patch contents are as follows

[b][Update History][/b]
1. Multi-display (dual monitor) support
2. Add automatic copy function after translation
3. Improve Chinese Recognition and Translation Accuracy
4. Modifying the Chinese Vertical Recognition bug
5. Correct multiple bugs, such as hidden errors in the taskbar
6. Optimizing the program optimization
   (Reduced performance impact when running at the same time as the game)
7. Add New Language - Turkish

That's about it. 

To improve the current character recognition and translation performance,
I'm trying. Please look forward to it.

Thank you.

tags.feature: 2. Add automatic copy function after translation

tags.bug: 4. Modifying the Chinese Vertical Recognition bug
5. Correct multiple bugs, such as hidden errors in the taskbar

notes.title: Notice of TAPP update !
notes.content:
Hello.
Thank you to all who use TAPP.

Please see the following patch progress.


1. Added translation function for vertical strings in specific languages
   (Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese)

2. Added re-translation function using the shortcut keys in the designated area

3. Add New Language (Thai, Portuguese)

4. Tutorial corrections and additions

5. Expose notice window for updates

6. Improvement of program reliability


Also,
Our plans for future program development are:


[b][Future Plan][/b]

Tuesday, the second week of every month.

- Add Response Language 
- Improves stability 


Tuesday the fourth week of every month

- Add new features 
- Improves stability


We'll decide on the topic of the update as above, and we'll continue to patch it.


The following new features are currently planned for renewal:

1. Automatic translation function according to the set time of the specified area
2. Multi-monitor support
3. Multi-area translation function
4. UI / UX full reorganization

in addition,
Always listen to users ’opinions,
We will develop the required functions with priority and strive to be reflected in the update.

Thank you very much.

tags.feature: 1. Added translation function for vertical strings in specific languages (Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese)
2. Added re-translation function using the shortcut keys in the designated area
